about: Personal Year = day of birth + month of birth + digit-sum of the target year, reduced fully to 1-9 (birth year not used; 11 and 22 reduce further). The story shows the current calendar year and the next one. Items come from two speakers: T01 and T03.

method.quote: add the day of birth, the month of birth, and the digits of the year being considered, reducing the result to a single digit
The speaker says not to include the birth year.

1.quote: progress may feel slow at first, and a person may feel stuck or underappreciated before opportunities become clearer
1.text: A new beginning after a dark phase. Progress may feel slow at first, and you may feel stuck or unappreciated before opportunities become clear.

1.quote: build a morning routine and make use of morning sunlight
1.text: Build a morning routine and make use of the morning sunlight.

1.quote: keeping a rising-sun image in the work area
1.text: Keep a rising-sun image in your work area.
Feed people on Sundays (a community meal, a shared meal, or food you prepare and give away). Generosity matters this year.

1.quote: For the second half of the year, the speaker advises dressing impressively
1.text: In the second half of the year, dress impressively.

1.quote: recommends respecting senior colleagues or business contacts
1.text: Respect elders, your father, and senior colleagues or business contacts.

1.quote: bringing a senior person—such as a retired military officer—into a position in the business
1.text: If your business is struggling, bring a senior person (for example, a retired military officer) into a position in it.

1.quote: associates personal year 1 with sunrise, visibility, name, and fame
1.text: A year of sunrise, visibility, name and fame.

1.quote: followed by stronger momentum after March or April
1.text: A slower start, then stronger momentum after March or April. The middle of the year is especially good for important plans.

1.quote: spend a few minutes watching the sunrise
1.text: Spend a few minutes watching the sunrise.

1.quote: not overcommitting, overpromising, or making large purchases early in the year
1.text: Don't overcommit, overpromise or make large purchases early in the year; move those plans to the second half.

1.quote: names yellow and orange as favorable colors

2.quote: associates year two with the Moon and the mind
2.text: A Moon year: the mind leans towards comfort, so a steady routine helps you most.

2.quote: follow a fixed routine: show up even when motivation is low, go to the office rather than defaulting to working from home, and maintain a proper work station
2.text: Follow a fixed routine: show up even when motivation is low, go to the office rather than working from home, and keep a proper work station.

2.quote: supporting a child’s education through school fees or books
2.text: Help someone going through hardship, especially by supporting a child's education with school fees or books.

2.quote: eating with more junior colleagues or team members about once a week
2.text: If you lead a team or business, eat with junior colleagues about once a week and take a caring, mother-like approach.

2.quote: year two may be a favorable time for property investment if one can afford it; if not, they suggest investing in silver instead
2.text: A favourable time for property investment if you can afford it; if not, invest in silver.

2.quote: looking at oneself in the mirror and offering oneself a compliment
2.text: Begin the day by looking in the mirror and giving yourself a compliment.

2.quote: favorable for marriage and for people considering conception
2.text: Favourable for marriage and for those planning a child.

2.quote: also for buying property or building a home
2.text: Good for buying property or building a home (keeping down payments and instalments in mind).

2.quote: getting advice from suitable people before moving forward
2.text: Take advice from the right people before moving forward.
Get enough sleep, especially before exams or presentations. Keep the day for work and the night for sleep.

2.quote: silver watch with a white or blue dial
2.text: A silver watch with a white or blue dial.

3.quote: compliment oneself, learn an idea, share it with three people, and start the day cheerfully
3.text: Start the day with Beauty, Knowledge and Laughter: compliment yourself, learn one idea, share it with three people, and begin cheerfully.

3.quote: potentially fortunate period for advancement, public recognition, or business growth
3.text: A potentially fortunate year for advancement, public recognition or business growth.

3.quote: repeatedly complaining about one’s work may reinforce dissatisfaction
3.text: Avoid repeatedly complaining about your work.

3.quote: learning a skill that increases professional value, and maintaining physical fitness
3.text: Study something new, learn a skill that raises your professional value, and stay fit. This prepares you for next year.
Opportunities for promotion and profit, especially through sales, speaking with people and strong presentations.

3.quote: warns against insults, gossip, and speaking badly about others
3.text: Avoid insults, gossip and speaking badly about others. Be kind with words.

3.quote: spending about 10 minutes between 5 p.m. and 9 p.m. reciting prayers
3.text: Spend about 10 minutes between 5 p.m. and 9 p.m. reciting prayers or devotional songs, loud enough to hear your own voice.

3.quote: favorable for job changes, promotions, and visa-related plans
3.text: Favourable for job changes, promotions and visa-related plans.

3.quote: gold or combinations of gold and silver
3.text: Gold, or gold-and-silver combinations: watches, bracelets or chains.

4.quote: focus on letting go rather than clinging to things
4.text: Focus on letting go rather than clinging to things.

4.quote: strengthening relationships and working bonds with teammates, stakeholders, vendors, and suppliers
4.text: Strengthen your bonds with teammates, stakeholders, vendors and suppliers, so you are less likely to be misunderstood.

4.quote: avoid taking large loans and to be careful with credit cards
4.text: Avoid large loans and be careful with credit cards. Don't spend money before it actually arrives.

4.quote: keeping one’s surroundings and records organized
4.text: Keep your surroundings and records organised: papers, insurance, licences, degrees, emails and chats.

4.quote: warns against withdrawing socially during year four
4.text: Don't withdraw socially. Attend seminars, webinars, meetings and professional gatherings.
Add extra time to your work, for example by starting half an hour early.

4.quote: results may depend on its placement in a birth chart
4.text: Rahu's placement in your birth chart shapes this year; a full chart reading needs your time and place of birth.

4.quote: begin learning early in the year
4.text: Begin learning early in the year: a certification, growing your business, a cooking course or personal finance.

4.quote: make the bed neatly each morning
4.text: The 'golden remedy': make your bed neatly every morning with clean, fresh bedding.
Use fragrances such as oud, rose or cedar, carry a piece of cinnamon, and apply a sandalwood mark on your forehead.

4.quote: adding half an hour to one’s work or study schedule
4.text: Add half an hour to your work or study schedule.

4.quote: steel watch with a blue dial
4.text: A steel watch with a blue dial.

5.quote: describes year five as a “breath of fresh air” after a difficult period
5.text: A breath of fresh air after a difficult period, with an urge to do something new.

5.quote: rather than rushing into a partnership
5.text: Don't rush into a partnership. Use the skills and experience of earlier years.
Actively expand your network: meet new people and introduce yourself confidently.

5.quote: lighting a ghee lamp by a tulsi plant each day
5.text: Keep plants and greenery healthy, and light a ghee lamp by a tulsi plant every day.

5.quote: putting water in a green glass bottle, leaving it in sunlight for one to two hours, and drinking it daily
5.text: If you feel stuck: keep water in a green glass bottle in sunlight for one to two hours and drink it daily.

5.quote: favorable for promotion, increased income, and growth
5.text: Favourable for promotion, higher income and growth, especially if last year was a struggle.

5.quote: leaving home with a tulsi leaf or green cardamom in the mouth
5.text: Care for a tulsi or other plants each morning, and leave home with a tulsi leaf or green cardamom in your mouth.
Look after your digestion: eat home-cooked food rather than too much restaurant food.
For strong results, walk 5 km a day: 2.5 km in the morning and 2.5 km in the evening.

5.quote: may suit people who want to travel or pursue further studies
meeting people cheerfully rather than angrily
may consider trading or the stock market
5.text: Trading or the stock market may be considered, but the decision is yours; do your own research.

5.quote: he recommends green, including a green watch dial or wallet
specifically suggests a metal watch with a green dial
5.text: A metal watch with a green dial.

6.quote: watch their spending and manage cash flow carefully
6.text: Watch your spending and manage cash flow carefully; expenses may rise.
Avoid unnecessary purchases. If you buy on instalments, prefer things that grow in value or earn income, such as gold or a home you can rent out.

6.quote: updating the wardrobe and discarding clothes that are no longer wanted
6.text: Refresh your wardrobe and let go of clothes you no longer want.

6.quote: potentially bringing progress such as marriage or having a baby
6.text: May bring progress such as marriage or a baby.

6.quote: seeking a change of role or workplace
6.text: Growth may come from a change of role or workplace, or from asking for more responsibility. Business owners: focus on sales, marketing and visibility.

6.quote: focus on health, food, and exercise
6.text: Focus on health, food and exercise; neglect could make the next two years harder.

6.quote: recommends a black obsidian bracelet as protection from surrounding negativity
6.text: A black obsidian bracelet for protection from negativity around you (men on the right hand, women on the left).

6.quote: favorable for marriage, pregnancy attempts, finding love, and students
6.text: Favourable for marriage, planning a pregnancy, finding love, and for students.

6.quote: better results are more likely in the second half of the year
6.text: A job change or income growth is more likely in the second half of the year.

6.quote: Money is described as potentially arriving and going quickly
6.text: Money may come and go quickly: spend thoughtfully, book profits, and increase savings and investments as your income grows.

6.quote: investing in metals such as gold or silver early in the year
6.text: Invest in gold or silver early in the year (or digitally, through ETFs).

6.quote: Keep nearby children happy through small gifts or treats
6.text: Keep the children around you happy with small gifts or treats.

6.quote: Pay attention to eye strain and possible changes in vision
6.text: Watch for eye strain and changes in vision.

6.quote: White, peach, pink, and green are recommended
6.text: White, peach, pink and green, with white and pink flowers at home.

6.quote: the speaker recommends a metal watch with a green dial, and also mentions silver-and-gold combinations
6.text: A metal watch with a green dial, or silver-and-gold combinations. Women may wear diamond earrings (lab-grown is fine).

6.quote: Avoid misunderstandings and impulsive reactions early in the year
6.text: Avoid misunderstandings and impulsive reactions early in the year.

7.quote: a period for introspection and new learning
7.text: A year for introspection and new learning; confidence may dip a little.

7.quote: start learning something early in the year
7.text: Start learning something early in the year.

7.quote: building a habit of going to the gym
7.text: Build a gym habit; what matters most is showing up regularly.

7.quote: bathing with a pinch of turmeric and drinking water in which a piece of cinnamon has soaked overnight in a silver cup
7.text: Bathe with a pinch of turmeric, and drink water in which a piece of cinnamon has soaked overnight in a silver cup (for allergies, frequent illness or low energy). Please also consult a doctor.

7.quote: writing down plans and instructions instead of relying on verbal communication
7.text: Write plans and instructions down, and meet in person for important matters rather than talking by phone.

7.quote: drawing the Ketu yantra and Mercury yantra in a notebook every day
7.text: If you feel stuck, draw the Ketu yantra and the Mercury yantra in a notebook every day.

7.quote: especially difficult for people whose name number is 4 or 8
7.text: This year can be harder if your name number is 4 or 8. Keep the kitchen clean and organised, and remove expired food.

7.quote: a year for fulfilling personal wishes
7.text: A year for fulfilling personal wishes, if you deliberately make time for yourself.

7.quote: devote one hour each morning to a personally chosen activity
7.text: Give one hour each morning to something you choose: reading, walking, quiet thinking or meditation.

7.quote: double-check emails and, for business owners, accounts
7.text: Study your work more deeply, and double-check emails (and accounts, if you run a business).

7.quote: favorable for education, certifications, and courses
7.text: Favourable for education, certifications and courses.

7.quote: Wednesday is mentioned as a good day to network
7.text: Go out in the evenings (a walk, a café or friends). Wednesday is a good day to network.

7.quote: checking vitamin D and B12 levels and getting blood work early in the year
7.text: Pay attention to hormonal health (cycles and thyroid; for men, weight gain). Check vitamin D and B12 and get blood work early in the year.

7.quote: yellow, white, gray, silver, and shades of pink
7.text: Yellow, white, grey, silver and shades of pink.

7.quote: Seek advice from a good investment adviser before investing
7.text: Buy gold or other metals early in the year, and take a good investment adviser's advice before investing.

7.quote: a gold, white-gold, or silver-and-gold bangle or metal watch
7.text: A gold, white-gold or silver-and-gold bangle or metal watch.

8.quote: may bring job loss or a sudden interruption in income
8.text: There may be a sudden change at work or a break in income. If it comes, treat it as a chance to see things from a new angle.

8.quote: drawing the Mercury yantra daily with a green pen and lighting a ghee lamp for Tulsi
8.text: Draw the Mercury yantra daily with a green pen and light a ghee lamp for Tulsi.

8.quote: checking whether one’s commonly used name aligns with one’s date of birth
8.text: Check whether the name you commonly use aligns with your date of birth.

8.quote: give up alcohol, smoking, and non-vegetarian food for the year
8.text: Try to give up alcohol, smoking and non-vegetarian food this year, and eat simple, sattvic food.

8.quote: recommends a black rutile quartz bracelet
8.text: A black rutile quartz bracelet (women on the left hand, men on the right). If that's not possible, carry five cloves in a small cloth pouch, replace them every Friday, and put the old cloves in soil.

8.quote: preparing machinery and the work area for possible equipment failures or hazards
8.text: Business owners: prepare machinery and the work area for possible equipment failures or hazards.

8.quote: favorable for buying land, but advises against borrowing money, pledging gold, or taking on debt
8.text: Favourable for buying land, but avoid borrowing, pledging gold or taking on debt.

8.quote: recommends exercises such as squats and lunges
8.text: Strengthen your legs with squats and lunges.
Opportunities to earn money, if you stay restrained: don't let others provoke you, and avoid reacting impulsively.
Do five minutes of pranayama after waking.

8.quote: either arriving half an hour earlier or staying half an hour later
8.text: Put in half an hour extra at work. Be a team player and spend time with junior colleagues.

8.quote: Keep the area outside the home or apartment clean and well lit
8.text: Keep the area outside your home clean and well lit.
The year may feel mixed, with some delays. Focus on what needs doing each day: win the day.

8.quote: drinking water kept overnight in a silver glass
8.text: A silver watch with a white or blue dial, or a silver bangle or chain. Drink water kept overnight in a silver glass.

8.quote: Recommended colors are black, blue, white, gray, and green
8.text: Black, blue, white, grey and green.

9.quote: be patient and avoid rushing through eating, conversations, driving, or work
9.text: Be patient: don't rush through eating, conversations, driving or work. Start preparing half an hour early and take a five-minute break every hour.

9.quote: working outside the home rather than working from home
9.text: Work outside the home rather than from home.

9.quote: drinking water from a copper bottle
9.text: Exercise, limit very spicy food, and drink water from a copper bottle.

9.quote: drawing a Mars yantra alongside the yantra associated with one’s birth number
9.text: Draw a Mars yantra alongside your birth-number yantra, light a lamp or candle at home morning and evening, and play a sport such as badminton, tennis, table tennis or squash.

9.quote: so that no one goes to sleep hungry
9.text: Help younger people, and feed someone so that no one goes to sleep hungry.

9.quote: favorable for going abroad, changing jobs, or expanding a business by opening a new branch
9.text: Favourable for going abroad, changing jobs or opening a new branch.

9.quote: advises avoiding black and favoring sun-related shades such as yellow and orange
avoiding a name number of 4 or 8
9.text: Avoid a name number of 4 or 8 this year.

9.quote: a chance to pursue major changes
9.text: A chance for major change: moving home, going abroad, transforming your lifestyle or health, preparing for government exams, or buying a home. Stay calm, and control your thoughts and actions.

9.quote: walking barefoot in nature for 10–15 minutes in the morning
9.text: Walk barefoot in nature for 10–15 minutes in the morning (on a green balcony if you live in a flat).

9.quote: spending time near a river, sea, or other substantial source of water early in the year
9.text: Spend time near a river or the sea early in the year.
Single-task: finish one task before taking the next call, and return calls afterwards.
If you have truly tried and a relationship still isn't working, it may be time to let it go. Happy couples can progress together and plan investments as a pair.

9.quote: Saffron, white, light blue, light gray, and black are recommended
9.text: Saffron, white, light blue, light grey and black.

9.quote: a red thread, a gold-colored watch with a gold dial, and investing in gold
9.text: A red thread, a gold-coloured watch with a gold dial, and investing in gold.
If you can't go outdoors, lift iron dumbbells.

for_everyone.quote: On Tuesdays, avoid eating after sunset.
for_everyone.text: On Tuesdays, avoid eating after sunset.
Seek blessings from older people, including the elders you meet in daily life.

for_everyone.quote: Play devotional recitations in the evening.
for_everyone.text: In the evening, between sunset and moonrise, play a bhajan, the Hanuman Chalisa or another recitation at home for 10–15 minutes.
